price_field: BSE daily settlement price, falling back to close where absent; on a contract's own expiry date, intrinsic value against the exchange's final settlement price of the index

fields.c0: call price at the session open, absent if it did not trade
fields.p0: put price at the session open, absent if it did not trade
fields.ohlc: [open, high, low, close] of the index that session
fields.lot: market lot for that expiry, as stated by the exchange
